gloss: to keep saying; to continue to say

definitions.gloss: to keep saying; to continue saying without stopping
definitions.explanation: To persist in saying something — repeatedly or over a sustained period. Compound of {言|い}う (to say) + {続|つづ}ける (to continue). Emphasizes persistence or repetition of speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{続|つづ}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He keeps saying the same thing over and over.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}→大丈夫：00772_daijoubu⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{言|い}い{続|つづ}けることで、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{励|はげ}ました→励ます：05304_hagemasu⟧。
examples.english: By continuing to say 'It'll be okay,' she encouraged herself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{信|しん}じて→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧⟦もらえなかった→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{真実|しんじつ}→真実：05316_shinjitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: Even though no one believed him, he kept saying the truth.

notes:
Compound verb: ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (godan) + ⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (ichidan). The combination is ichidan. The ～続ける suffix attaches to the verb stem and means 'to continue doing'. Can express both repeated statements over time and a sustained stream of speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{続|つづ}ける: to keep saying the same thing
- {言|い}い{続|つづ}けてきた: has been saying (for a long time)
- ⟦{主張|しゅちょう}→主張：03220_shuchou⟧し⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to keep insisting (related pattern)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{言|い}い{張|は}る→言い張る：29079_iiharu⟧: to insist, to maintain — implies stubborn insistence
- ⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}し→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to repeat, to say again and again — emphasizes repetition
